offensiveAbilities.name: Chupar
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The chupacabra has a creature Grabbed

Effect The chupacabra sucks blood from the grabbed creature. The chupacabra gains the Quickened condition for 1 minute and can use the extra action only for Strike and Stride actions. A chupacabra can't use Chupar again while it is quickened in this way.

A creature that has its blood drained by a chupacabra is Drained 1 until it receives healing (of any kind or amount).

offensiveAbilities.name: Pounce
offensiveAbilities.description: The chupacabra Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the chupacabra began this action Hidden, it remains hidden until after this ability's Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wing Flurry
offensiveAbilities.description: The false devil's spiny wings don't afford it a typical melee option, but it can use them to scrape and slash at foes it flies by. The winged chupacabra attempts to Tumble Through an enemy's space. As it does so, it flaps its wings furiously, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to its Acrobatics check. If it succeeds, it inflicts 4d6 Slashing Damage damage to the creature it Tumbled Through (or 8d6 Slashing Damage damage on a critical success).

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
